notes: Official API model ID muse-voice-transcribe-1.0: speech to text over the realtime WebSocket endpoint (wss://api.meta.ai/v1/asr/realtime) or the file endpoint POST /v1/asr/transcribe. $0.18 per hour of audio processed, the same for streaming and file transcription. Streaming diarization, endpointing, keyword biasing and 25 evaluated languages; no word-level timestamps. Null V1 token fields mean not applicable, not free. Availability varies by country under Meta's Geographic Use Policy. Meta does not publish a release date or Batch rate.

price_records.billing_note: Meta Model API pay-as-you-go price for audio processed, metered in whole seconds (rounded down). Streaming (realtime WebSocket) and file transcription cost the same, and zero data retention is priced at parity. Contributor mode is not available.
